json.overall_experience: The Climate Change Analyst likely found Basecamp to be a generally effective tool for coordinating project work within their Think Tank. While the platform offered clear tools for managing tasks and deadlines, the initial setup and certain limitations, particularly the single-project free plan, may have caused some minor frustrations. Despite these, the long-term usage suggests it adequately met their core project coordination needs.
